segments.name: Mining
segments.description: Operates the Avino mine in Mexico, producing and selling silver, copper and gold contained in concentrate shipments to a small number of customers.
segments.evidence: We have determined there is a single reportable operating segment as of December 31, 2024.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from customers, concentrated in two main buyers, who pay for shipments of silver, copper and gold concentrate, net of penalties, treatment costs and refining charges.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's revenues for the year ended December 31, 2024 of $ 66,178 (December 31, 2023 - $ 43,889 ) are all attributable to Mexico, from shipments of concentrate.
